dossier.stage_and_modality: Clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies with CD19-targeted programs entering clinical development.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases using CD19 CAR-T approach.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology that generates CAR-T cells directly within patients.
dossier.last_significant_event: Raised $122 million Series B funding in May 2026 and strengthened advisory board with key appointments as CD19 CAR-T program advances to clinical stage.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with lead asset TSRA-196 for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, alongside preclinical in vivo CAR-T and sickle cell disease programs.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Most recent preclinical data presented at ASGCT 2026 showing advancements in in vivo sickle cell disease therapy and in vivo CAR-T applications.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (clinical stage), sickle cell disease, and CAR-T applications across multiple indications.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo gene editing platform technology enabling direct therapeutic delivery without ex vivo cell manipulation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach that challenges traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy methods by enabling direct in vivo genetic modification.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of new preclinical data for in vivo sickle cell disease and CAR-T applications at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.

dossier.best_disclosed_data: Addition Therapeutics presented preclinical proof-of-concept data at the ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presented preclinical proof-of-concept data at ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting on May 12, 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using viral vector delivery systems.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting patients in a Phase 1 dose-escalation study (NCT06528301) evaluating UB-VV111 in relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including large B-cell lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and multiple myeloma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Viral vector-based in vivo CAR-T platform, as evidenced by asset naming convention UB-VV111 and UB-VV500.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual-target in vivo CAR-T approach for multiple myeloma (UB-VV500), distinguishing from single-target competitors.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 announcement of UB-VV500 dual-target CAR-T data presentation at the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy Annual Meeting.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 stage with CPTX2309 asset currently recruiting in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No disclosed efficacy or safety data available from the ongoing Phase 1 trial NCT06917742.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus as disclosed target indications.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and autoimmune disease patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies. Currently recruiting patients for their lead program KLN-1010.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT07075185) evaluating safety, tolerability, and recommended Phase 2 dose of KLN-1010 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma, specifically targeting relapsed or refractory disease.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology with lead asset KLN-1010.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquisition by Eli Lilly for $7 billion in April 2026, described as the largest in vivo CAR-T deal to date.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies delivered via direct injection. Currently has 4 investigator-initiated trials across hematologic malignancies and autoimmune diseases.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting relapsed/refractory B-cell hematologic malignancies including multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also pursuing refractory autoimmune diseases with CD19/BCMA targeting approach.
dossier.delivery_approach: Direct injection delivery platform with lead assets JY231 for B-cell malignancies and JY232 for multiple myeloma. Utilizes dual CD19/BCMA targeting for autoimmune applications.
dossier.key_differentiators: Developing injectable in vivo CAR-T approach that eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing. Expanding beyond oncology into autoimmune disease applications with dual antigen targeting strategy.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting status for multiple clinical trials in 2024, including Early Phase 1 trial for JY232 in multiple myeloma (NCT07336823).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical development with two assets (HN2301 and HN2302) targeting autoimmune diseases. Company has three active Phase 1 trials and one terminated trial.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and systemic sclerosis (scleroderma). One trial specifically targets refractory myasthenia gravis.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of recruiting for Phase 1 trial NCT06801119 evaluating HN2301 in systemic lupus erythematosus and scleroderma patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell generation using both viral and non-viral vector approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells without double-stranded DNA breaks, published in Nature.
dossier.indications_pursued: Cancer, autoimmune diseases, and systemic rheumatic diseases.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform utilizing both viral vectors and non-viral nanotechnology-enhanced delivery systems for in vivo CAR-T generation.
dossier.key_differentiators: Eliminates ex vivo manufacturing bottlenecks through scalable in vivo CAR-T production. Non-viral integration approach avoids double-stranded DNA breaks in primary human T cells.
dossier.last_significant_event: Publication in Nature demonstrating non-viral targeted integration technology in primary human T cells (April 2026).

dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral cell therapy approach developed in collaboration with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI through a Center of Excellence.
dossier.last_significant_event: Established Center of Excellence with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI to develop advanced, non-viral cell therapies (April 2026).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage developing in vivo CAR-T cell engineering using their TRAC platform technology.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First-in-primate data for in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering presented at ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.delivery_approach: TRAC platform technology for direct in vivo engineering of CAR-T cells.
dossier.key_differentiators: TRAC platform enables direct in vivo CAR-T cell engineering, potentially eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: Late-breaking oral presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026 showing first-in-primate in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering data.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 development with EN-374 gene therapy currently recruiting for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 completion of MGTA-145 in healthy volunteers, though specific efficacy or safety data are not disclosed.
dossier.indications_pursued: Primary focus on X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374. Previously pursued sickle cell disease and stem cell mobilization applications with MGTA-145.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 recruiting trial for EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease (NCT06876363).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T cell therapy approach. Currently has three active Phase 1 trials with assets SC262 and SC291.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for SG293 surrogate showing cell-specific delivery, potent CAR T cell generation, and deep B cell depletion in non-human primates as of May 2026.
dossier.indications_pursued: Oncology indications including Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Also targeting autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T cell therapy platform with cell-specific delivery mechanism demonstrated in preclinical studies.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo approach eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing typical of traditional CAR-T therapies. Cell-specific delivery technology enables direct in vivo CAR T cell generation.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of preclinical data for in vivo CAR T cell therapy SG293 surrogate demonstrating efficacy in non-human primates in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with intramuscular delivery approach for solid tumors. EVM14 is administered as an intramuscular injection alone or in combination with pembrolizumab.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 3 completion for Nefecon in Primary Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy in Chinese patients. Currently recruiting Phase 1/2 trial for EVM14 in selected solid tumors evaluating safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy.
dossier.indications_pursued: Selected solid tumors (EVM14), primary membranous nephropathy (EVER001), and primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (Nefecon). Also developing COVID-19 booster vaccination (PTX-COVID19-B).
dossier.delivery_approach: Intramuscular injection for EVM14 in solid tumors. Oral delivery for EVER001 as a highly selective, reversible, covalent Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 features high selectivity over other kinases as a covalent BTK inhibitor for proteinuric glomerular diseases. EVM14 is being evaluated both as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 recruiting trial for EVM14 in selected solid tumors (NCT07095868). Completion of Phase 3 open-label extension study for Nefecon in Chinese IgAN patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies using circular RNA delivered via lipid nanoparticles. Currently has two Phase 1 trials recruiting, including one testing CD19 CAR-T for autoimmune diseases.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Limited disclosed data available, with Phase 1 trials currently recruiting for both healthy volunteers (ORN252) and autoimmune disease patients (TI-0032-III). No efficacy or safety data has been reported from these ongoing studies.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome with CD19 CAR-T therapy. Also developing ORN252 for undisclosed indications based on healthy volunteer testing.
dossier.delivery_approach: Uses lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) to deliver circular RNA encoding chimeric antigen receptors directly to T cells in vivo. The circular RNA platform eliminates the need for ex vivo cell manufacturing.
dossier.key_differentiators: Utilizes circular RNA instead of traditional viral vectors or mRNA for in vivo CAR-T delivery. Targets autoimmune diseases with CD19 CAR-T, which is a less common application compared to oncology-focused approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: May 2026 presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting showcasing clinical-ready circular RNA in vivo CAR-T pipeline. This appears to coincide with ongoing Phase 1 trial recruitment activities.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase I/II clinical stage company developing CAR-T cell therapies with at least two assets in active trials.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with anti-GPRC5D CAR-T (OriCAR-017) and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with GPC3-directed CAR-T (Ori-C101).
dossier.delivery_approach: Conventional CAR-T cell injection approach targeting GPRC5D and GPC3 antigens.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focuses on GPRC5D targeting for multiple myeloma and GPC3 targeting for hepatocellular carcinoma, representing potentially differentiated antigen approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of first U.S. clinical study (NCT06271252) evaluating OriCAR-017 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing ex vivo CAR-T therapies. Multiple trials active with CT041 and CT011 assets targeting solid tumors.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: CT041 (anti-Claudin18.2 CAR-T) has reached Phase 1b/2 trials in gastric and pancreatic cancers across multiple studies. Zevorcabtagene autoleucel has advanced to post-marketing Phase IV studies in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Also targeting relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell approach based on clinical trial data. No in vivo delivery platform identified from available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on Claudin18.2 targeting for solid tumors with CT041. Has achieved commercial approval for at least one product (zevorcabtagene autoleucel) given post-marketing studies.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of CT011 Phase Ib trial for hepatocellular carcinoma (NCT06560827, currently recruiting as of latest data).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical development with in vivo CAR-T delivery approach. Company has multiple assets in Phase 1 trials including IMV101 and IMV102 for hematologic malignancies.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for IMV102 demonstrating durable tumor control presented at AACR 2026. Clinical data from ongoing Phase 1 trials has not been reported yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma with in vivo assets. Solid tumors including CLDN18.2-positive gastric, pancreatic, and digestive system cancers with ex vivo CAR-T approach.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach utilizing both in vivo CAR-T delivery (IMV101, IMV102) and traditional ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing (IMC002). In vivo assets appear to target hematologic indications while ex vivo approach focuses on solid tumors.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo CAR-T platform potentially eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and patient-specific production timelines. Targeting both liquid and solid tumor indications with modality-specific approaches.
dossier.last_significant_event: Presentation of preclinical data for IMV102 in vivo CAR-T candidate showing durable tumor control at AACR 2026 in April 2026.
